svg.title: Neural network diagram
svg.desc: Convolutional neural network with 8 layers: Input (32×32×3), Conv 1 (conv 3×3, 32×32×16), Conv 2 (conv 3×3, 32×32×16), Conv 3 (conv 3×3, 32×32×16), Conv 4 (conv 3×3, 32×32×16), Conv 5 (conv 3×3, 32×32×16), Global pool (global avg, 16 values), Output (10 values).
